7.6 Security Events
Firewalls are a crucial part of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), as they are monitoring
the complete network traffic and are thus able to identify attacks within the in-vehicle
network. AUTOSAR specifies the vehicle part of an IDS within the IdsM (IDS Man-
ager), which aggregates and qualifies security events raised by IDS sensors and for-
wards them to the configured sink, either the persistent memory or the vehicle-central
IDS instance (IdsR in the AUTOSAR IDS concept).
The Firewall supports the IDS by acting as an IDS sensor and raising security events
(SEvs) to the IdsM. To this end, the Firewall specifies a set of SEvs (see Sec. 7.6.1)
as well as conditions on when to raise them (see Sec. 7.6.2).
